_: The two hand-kept halves of one rule: nothing in Steward is German.
The list of German words is NOT here. It is derived, by both tests that enforce this rule,
bilingual bundle this project maintains anyway, which is 601 words of real German and grows
on its own. What is here is only what a derivation cannot know.
Read by steward-ui/frontend/src/language.test.ts and by NothingIsGermanTest. One file, because
two copies of a rule is one copy that is quietly out of date.
_alsoEnglish: Words that are in the German bundle and are also English words. Every one was checked by
hand against the sources here. This list is expected to grow by one whenever an English
sentence trips it - the test goes red once, somebody reads the word, and adds it. That is the
right failure: loud, and one line to answer. A guard that reports a false positive and is
then deleted is the failure this shape avoids.
_extra: German words that the bundle does not contain and that were found in Steward anyway. This is
the memory of what actually leaked - it is not a dictionary and must not become one.
_abbreviations: Not words, so they are not caught by a word boundary. `z. B.` is the one that was actually
